name: Short Spine Massage
summary: Feet in straps, legs lift overhead and the spine rolls down one bone at a time.
steps: Headrest down. Feet in the long loops, legs straight up just in front of the hips.
Breathe out, tip the pelvis and peel the spine up until the weight rests across the upper back.
Breathe in to turn the legs out and bend the knees into a diamond, heels together.
Breathe out to keep the diamond as the spine rolls down one bone at a time.
Finish with one frog press towards the footbar.

layers.title: Legs up and over
layers.text: Fold at the hips and roll onto the shoulders; bend the knees and roll down.

layers.title: Slow the roll down
layers.text: Six counts, heels staying close to the seat.

layers.title: Pause at the top
layers.text: One breath balanced on the shoulders with the frog legs.

cautions.note: Weight passes onto the shoulders; avoid with neck problems.

cues:
Weight on the shoulders, never the neck.
Knees stay shoulder-width on the way down — not folded into the chest.
Slow down; no dropping.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
